mutations.find:
- run: python3 .org-check/data-check/check.py target
      # The two steps below run even when the data check fails, so both

      - name: Install gitleaks
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: sh .org-check/secret-scan/install.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Secret scan
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: sh .org-check/secret-scan/scan.sh target
mutations.replace:
- name: Install gitleaks
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: sh .org-check/secret-scan/install.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/gitleaks" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Secret scan
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: sh .org-check/secret-scan/scan.sh target
      - run: python3 .org-check/data-check/check.py target
